items.reason: Detail status uses the same menu builder with the detail’s container.
Detail y opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail m opens the Mute menu targeting its container.
Both surfaces dispatch I through the shared runFlatVerb helper.
An active drain picker takes rendering precedence over the detail.
Direct y and p handling is removed from document peeks.
Neither detail list handles p directly.
Existing item and artifact r-menu paths remain intact.
Status refusal uses the shared wording and renders on the detail’s hint line.
Copy refusal uses the shared wording and renders on the detail’s hint line.
Mute refusal uses the shared wording and renders on the detail’s hint line.
Container menus occupy Frame.Block, with their height deducted from the body budget.
Detail menus delegate navigation and dispatch to the existing menu handlers.
Menu Escape clears the menu while preserving the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection and construct singular menus.
Slash starts detail search; Enter applies it and restores normal detail handling.
Lowercased substring matching ANDs terms across item id, title and type.
Item status is excluded from search fields.
Artifact filtering uses the same grammar over filename and type.
Escape discards the buffer and reapplies the previous term.
Slash creates an empty buffer, and applying it restores all rows.
The typing handler captures printable keys, including j, k, v and r.
Poll synchronization filters refreshed lists using the detail’s active query.
The applied term appears in the detail header.
Empty search results name the query and explain how to clear it.
Artifact availability depends on the complete collection, preserving v after filtering.
Detail search state is separate and disappears when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise r, s, y, m and / without flat copy keys.
Peek hints no longer advertise direct name or path copying.
Typing hints list only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help includes menus, applicable I, search and conditional clearing; peek help drops flat copying.
Help handles detail typing and container menus contextually, omitting hidden-row navigation.

scores.rationale: Clear reuse of existing infrastructure with substantial regression coverage; exact layout sizing and some artifact/help edge cases lack direct tests.
